supporting_quotes.exact: Binary search tree, also called an ordered or sorted binary tree, is a rooted binary tree data structure with the key of each internal node being greater than all the keys in the respective node's left subtree and less than the ones in its right subtree.
The time complexity of operations on the binary search tree is linear with respect to the height of the tree.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-6c9f3729e870 [0,254) 完整给出 claim 中的定义性断言：'ordered or sorted' 对应'有序/排序'，'rooted binary tree' 对应'有根二叉树'，'greater than all the keys in the respective node's left subtree and less than the ones in its right subtree' 对应键序性质；引文 evidence-25a94489f8e2 [0,109) 中 'linear with respect to the height of the tree' 与'时间复杂度与树高成线性关系'逐词对应。两条引文为同一来源、语义一致、无冲突，claim 全部成分均有引文直接支持。

observations.subject: BST
observations.object: rooted binary tree with per-node key ordering property

supporting_quotes.exact: Binary search trees allow binary search for fast lookup, addition, and removal of data items. Since the nodes in a BST are laid out so that each comparison skips about half of the remaining tree, the lookup performance is proportional to that of binary logarithm.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-8fd0ef8100e7 [0,263) 逐短语覆盖 claim：'fast lookup, addition, and removal' 对应'快速查找、添加和删除'，'each comparison skips about half of the remaining tree' 对应'每次比较都跳过剩余树的大约一半'，'lookup performance is proportional to that of binary logarithm' 对应'查找性能正比于二分对数'。引文含全部断言成分，无遗漏、无冲突。

observations.subject: BST
observations.object: binary search for lookup, addition, removal

supporting_quotes.exact: BSTs were devised in the 1960s for the problem of efficient storage of labeled data and are attributed to Conway Berners-Lee and David Wheeler.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-3aa8c8e52e3e [0,144) 与 claim 逐项对应：'in the 1960s' 对应'1960 年代'，'for the problem of efficient storage of labeled data' 对应'为高效存储带标签数据的问题'，'attributed to Conway Berners-Lee and David Wheeler' 对应'归于……名下'。claim 无超出引文的内容。

supporting_quotes.exact: The performance of a binary search tree is dependent on the order of insertion of the nodes into the tree since arbitrary insertions may lead to degeneracy; several variations of the binary search tree can be built with guaranteed worst-case performance.

In worst case, successive operations in the binary search tree may lead to degeneracy and form a singly linked list (or "unbalanced tree") like structure, thus has the same worst-case complexity as a linked list.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-30007c0cb00e [0,255) 覆盖'性能依赖插入顺序'（'dependent on the order of insertion'）、'任意插入可能导致退化'（'arbitrary insertions may lead to degeneracy'）与'变体提供有保证的最坏情况性能'（'guaranteed worst-case performance'）；引文 evidence-54af1c56b7d6 [0,213) 覆盖'退化为单链表状（不平衡树）结构'（'singly linked list (or "unbalanced tree") like structure'）与'最坏复杂度与链表相同'（'same worst-case complexity as a linked list'）。两条引文互补无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: Binary search trees are also a fundamental data structure used in construction of abstract data structures such as sets, multisets, and associative arrays.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-d5faef464cb6 [0,154) 中 'fundamental data structure used in construction of abstract data structures such as sets, multisets, and associative arrays' 与 claim 的'构造 set、multiset、关联数组等抽象数据结构的基础数据结构'完全对应，含全部名目成分。

supporting_quotes.exact: If Z has only one child, the child node of Z gets elevated by modifying the parent node of Z to point to the child node, consequently taking Z's position in the tree, as shown in (b) and (c).

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-af0e76f257a0 [0,191) 中 'modifying the parent node of Z to point to the child node, consequently taking Z's position' 与'修改 Z 的父节点使其指向该孩子节点，孩子随之顶替 Z 在树中的位置'逐句对应，前提 'If Z has only one child' 与'只有一个孩子'一致。

observations.subject: deletion of node with one child
observations.object: parent of Z points to Z's child

supporting_quotes.exact: If Z has both left and right children, the in-order successor of Z, say Y, displaces Z by following the two cases:
If Y is Z's right child, Y displaces Z and Y's right child remain unchanged.
If Y lies within Z's right subtree but is not Z's right child, Y first gets replaced by its own right child, and then it displaces Z's position in the tree.
Alternatively, the in-order predecessor can also be used.

claims.rationale: 四条引文按序覆盖 claim 各成分：evidence-ff0802491fcb [0,115) 给出前提'both left and right children'与'用中序后继 Y 顶替 Z'（'in-order successor of Z, say Y, displaces Z'）；evidence-2b52cbf6cd14 [0,76) 对应'Y 是 Z 的右孩子'情形及'Y 的右孩子保持不变'；evidence-c6bb2944b119 [0,156) 对应'Y 在右子树内但不是右孩子'情形（'first gets replaced by its own right child, and then it displaces Z's position'）；evidence-aadcbd15a301 [0,57) 对应'也可以改用中序前驱'（'the in-order predecessor can also be used'）。四者构成同一算法的完整且一致的分支描述。

observations.subject: deletion of node with two children
case: Y is Z's right child
observations.object: Y displaces Z, Y's right child unchanged

observations.subject: case: Y in Z's right subtree, not right child
observations.object: Y replaced by its right child, then displaces Z

supporting_quotes.exact: Inorder tree walk: Nodes from the left subtree get visited first, followed by the root node and right subtree. Such a traversal visits all the nodes in the order of non-decreasing key sequence.
Preorder tree walk: The root node gets visited first, followed by left and right subtrees.
Postorder tree walk: Nodes from the left subtree get visited first, followed by the right subtree, and finally, the root.

claims.rationale: 三条引文分别对应三种遍历：evidence-b2b0afcf337e [0,193) 给出中序顺序'left subtree first, then root, then right subtree'与'non-decreasing key sequence'；evidence-c1634aa0ad23 [0,90) 给出'root node gets visited first'（前序先访问根）；evidence-8d3abacce66c [0,121) 给出'finally, the root'（后序最后访问根）。claim 的'先左、再根、后右'与'非降键序'、'先访问根'、'最后访问根'均有对应引文。

supporting_quotes.exact: There are several self-balanced binary search trees, including T-tree, treap, red-black tree, B-tree, 2–3 tree, and Splay tree.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-109717c4bbe1 [0,127) 列举'including T-tree, treap, red-black tree, B-tree, 2–3 tree, and Splay tree'，与 claim 列出的六种自平衡 BST 逐一对应（含 '2–3 tree' 的 en-dash 与 claim 中'2–3 树'一致）。claim 未超出引文内容。

observations.object: T-tree, treap, red-black tree, B-tree, 2–3 tree, Splay tree

supporting_quotes.exact: Binary search trees are used in sorting algorithms such as tree sort, where all the elements are inserted at once and the tree is traversed at an in-order fashion. BSTs are also used in quicksort.
Binary search trees are used in implementing priority queues, using the node's key as priorities.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-1a2ba9876653 [0,196) 对应'tree sort'应用（'all the elements are inserted at once and the tree is traversed at an in-order fashion'）与 quicksort；引文 evidence-4e4f979c165d [0,97) 对应'用节点的键作为优先级来实现优先队列'（'implementing priority queues, using the node's key as priorities'）。两条引文无冲突，共同完整支撑 claim。

qualifiers.treeSortMechanism: all elements inserted at once, in-order traversal
